alignments.note: Substantival adjective the ASV writes bare as *Many*.
Construct noun with a supplied *the* under rule 29.
Rectum with the chain's *of* under rule 19, a supplied determiner under rule 15 and the generic *man* supplied to expand the substantival adjective; head on the lexeme under rule 31.
Quantifier with the generic noun supplied to complete it, joining its unit under rule 31 and headed on the quantifier.
The ASV writes *a friend*, not *the friend*, so no *the* answers to this article; unrepresented under rule 29.
Predicate nominal with the construction-supplied copula under rule 20 and the indefinite article under rule 15.

The nominal `אִישׁ מַתָּן` is recast as a head noun and a relative clause of giving; the supplied antecedent, relative and verb join this noun's unit under rule 46's closing paragraph, headed as rule 43 heads `בַּעַל כְּנָפַיִם` on *hath*.

review_notes: The margin's *a prince* was read and set aside under rule 38.
The recasting of `אִישׁ מַתָּן` as *him that giveth gifts* leaves the head on the supplied verb, since no English word writes `אִישׁ`'s own lexeme.
